body:
Plan (30 Oct): you don't do manual work, so the game update clears them.
Remove: game forest trees on the horse trail, dirt roads, jump field and building spots.
Keep: the rest, so the farm stays a bit hidden.
Known now: 18 trees on trail/roads; 90 inside farm + jump field (not all go).
How many go in total: unknown until marked in the Area plan.
Left (tool work, sent to Plan): mark them deleted in the Area plan, before/after pictures for your OK.
short: Game update removes forest trees on farm paths and fields
title: Farm forest: clear paths and fields
